description.narrative: Project Development Objective (PDO) is to improve the availability of quality maternal, neonatal, child, and adolescent health and nutrition services and their equitable utilization in the selected regions.

The objective of the Health System Support Project for Mauritania is to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality, and stunting among children under five years of age and to enhance national health system capacities for pandemic preparedness. The project has four components. (1) Improve quality and increase use of RMNCAH-N services subcomponent will support improvement in the quality of RMNCAH-N service delivery and establish financial frameworks aligned with the national vision to pool financial resources for UHC. (2) Strengthen health system component will enhance cross-sectoral and multistakeholder coordination and establish regulatory frameworks to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of health systems toward achieving UHC. (3) Project management, monitoring and evaluation (M&E) component will finance operating costs, consultancy services, and some equipment for the National PBF Unit and the Project Implementation Unit (PIU). (4) Contingent Emergency Response Component will allow for rapid reallocation of credit/grant uncommitted funds in the event of an eligible emergency.
